claim.text: Existing authenticated inline advanced SharedData v2/v3 callbacks can be prepared as value-free raw owners and decoded later with the same operation budget.
claim.scope: One already authenticated inline mark, existing layouts and coordinate owners; not raw Compact framing or native root admission.
claim.root_adversary: ROBUST within the semantic-delay, foreign-owner, budget-identity, detached-Copy and external raw-state factory/constructor attacks actually executed
claim.global_goal: ACTIVE; full Compact JSON/native/public/offline, remaining types/MV/projection support and later performance work remain open

risk.boundary: Raw preparation versus semantic value decoding and source-bound holder construction
risk.rollback: One exact-path local atomic commit over the baseline; no push or history rewrite.

admitted: prepare_inline authenticates callback roles, source pairs, raw bucket/Copy extents and original callback-local chunk-header spans without ObjectDocument/BinaryValue decoding.
decode_prepared reuses the existing AdvancedChunkCodec and enforces the exact retained physical owner and read-budget identity.
Only prepare_from_source can mint the holder; seal and the generated new are private.
Raw Copy/path bytes are owned snapshots; mutating a captured Copy slice after preparation does not alter the decoded values.
Legacy decode delegates through both phases; its caller contract and supported versions are retained.
